models.composition: The Wall (UNH Museum of Art collection, 2007.8)
models.qualification: University-published physical bronze sculpture by Sumner Winebaum, 2002, collection 2007.8. The exact model carries a current CC BY 4.0 grant and provides the museum catalogue details and exhibition history. ROOT reviewed the adult naturalistic rear reference and approved source acquisition. Credit Winebaum, the UNH collection and CatLAB. The artwork is not designated public domain. Native front, above and reverse views must confirm the whole figure and wooden base. The initial reference faces the rear. Authenticated download metadata must establish the exact representation and byte count.

models.composition: Male Torso (source title: Heroic Male Torso, Delos)
models.qualification: Current CC BY 4.0 model depicts a textured ancient-looking adult muscular torso with buttocks and metal support pins on a marble base. ROOT approved adult body fit and source acquisition to support identification. Public model metadata explicitly reports isAiGenerated false, unrigged OBJ with one 8192-pixel texture. Exact capture application is unrecorded. The source reports Delos Museum and a Hellenistic date, but museum identity, date and a suggested Herakles identification remain uncorroborated. Do not publish those as established facts. Native inspection must distinguish historical fragment breaks from capture loss. Admission remains pending physical-object matching and quality review.

models.composition: Nuts About You (handmade example published in 2021)
models.qualification: Current CC BY 4.0 model by Paspro360 identifies Shaun Gagg and links George Thornton Art. The artist website and gallery independently confirm the physical sculpture: a curving female rear torso made from steel nuts with chain-link hair. The artist photograph was actually compared with the model reference and confirms the composition. ROOT approved adult body fit and source acquisition. Exact handmade example, date, holding collection and measurements are unrecorded. Do not apply dimensions from another example or use a retail-listing date as the artwork date. Preserve source material and the designed openings between nuts; inspect top, interior, reverse and boundary capture without inventing a solid front. No model capture application is asserted.
